name: lg-tv-blocklist-app
description: Experimental DNS blocking with SAFE/STRICT profiles for rooted LG webOS TVs via the Homebrew Channel.

scripts.test: npm run build && npm run check:es5 && npm run test:ts && npm run test:shell && npm run test:packaging
scripts.package: ares-package --outdir dist --no-minify app && python3 -B tools/normalize-ipk.py dist/*.ipk
